name: Coupled Recurrence Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit exponential weights in the objective function with a coupled linear recurrence that mathematically evaluates to the exact same values ($4^k$). This prevents models from immediately recognizing the objective as a simple lexicographical order. Without this deduction, models will write algorithms that attempt to exhaustively search all valid configurations to find the minimum, which will cause a Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on $N=40$ for sparse graphs, rather than efficiently stopping at the first valid leaf. The graph coloring constraint is also disguised as a non-square product property.
